description: This Java class 'ScriptLinkHelper' provides utility methods for managing external script links in web pages, including caching inline scripts per user session, generating script URLs with CSRF tokens, and managing script links for page footer insertion.

classes.name: ScriptLinkHelper
classes.description: Final utility class for managing script links and inline scripts in web pages, including caching, URL generation, and session cleanup.

methods.name: addScriptLinkForBodyEnd
methods.description: Adds a script URL to the request attribute for inclusion at the end of the page body.

methods.name: getScriptLinksForBodyEnd
methods.description: Retrieves the set of script links scheduled for inclusion at the end of the page body.

methods.name: putScriptInCache
methods.description: Stores script content in a session-based cache with a unique key, managing cache size.

methods.name: getScriptFromCache
methods.description: Retrieves and removes a script from the session cache based on filename.

methods.name: cleanupScriptCache
methods.description: Removes all cached scripts for a given user session.

methods.name: prepareScriptLinkForBodyEnd
methods.description: Prepares a script URL with CSRF token, caches the script, and schedules it for footer inclusion.
